unmapped_examples: An agent scans the check register for stale uncashed items, applies state dormancy rules, generates due diligence letters, and produces unclaimed property filings.
An agent drives an old ERP or bank web portal through its UI to complete routine finance tasks that have no API.
An agent that finds stale checks and dormant credits in the ledger, applies each state's dormancy rules, drafts due-diligence letters, and builds the state filing.
Upload a legacy Excel model and AI maps its dependencies, explains each tab in plain English, flags hardcodes and errors, and optionally rebuilds it as clean documented logic.
A user records themselves doing a repetitive portal task once while narrating, and the system generates an editable step flowchart and a reusable computer-use automation.
Scans outstanding checks, applies state-specific dormancy rules, sends due diligence letters, tracks responses, and produces state-format unclaimed property filings.
A computer-use or browser agent logs into legacy bank, state tax, or payroll portals, downloads statements or files forms, and outputs clean structured data.
An agent logs into state tax, bank, or benefits portals that lack APIs and files forms or downloads statements through the UI.
Scans a check register, determines which uncashed checks are dormant and which state has jurisdiction, generates due-diligence letters, and outputs NAUPA-format filings.
A system that scans the ledger for stale uncashed checks and unused credits, applies each state's dormancy rules, drafts due diligence letters and outputs the filing.
Flags aging vendor checks and customer credits, applies each state's dormancy rules, generates due-diligence letters, and prepares the state filing.
An agent that logs into a mock bank portal or legacy ERP UI with no API and performs the data entry a human would.
Scans ledgers for stale uncashed checks and dormant credits, applies each state's dormancy rule, and generates due diligence letters and pre-filled filings.
Parses legacy Excel and VBA finance models, generates documented Python or SQL equivalents, and verifies them by diffing outputs on historical inputs.
Parses a fragile spreadsheet, infers what each part does, and generates tested code that reproduces its output while flagging bugs in the original.
A computer-use agent logs into legacy websites and portals, downloads or uploads documents, and syncs the data into a modern system, pausing for human approval before any submission.
An agent documents the logic of a spreadsheet or VBA-heavy financial model, flags fragile formulas, and regenerates it as tested Python or SQL, with natural-language Q&A over the model.
An agent flags stale uncashed checks and unclaimed refunds, generates state due-diligence letters, tries to reach payees, and uses a computer-use agent to file with state portals.
A browser agent that logs into clunky government, utility, vendor and bank portals without APIs, downloads statements and filings, and files them into the accounting system.
